title: Precomposition of free abelian representables restricts sections
statement: Let X be a scheme, A and B objects of its small etale site, a:A→B a site morphism, F an abelian sheaf, and f:Z[B]→F a morphism from the free abelian representable sheaf. Under the sections equivalence of [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-comparison-data], the composite Z[a] followed by f corresponds to F(a) applied to the section corresponding to f. No open immersion or nonemptiness assumption is needed.

source.place: EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv and freeSectionsEquiv; naturality in the representing object, from Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Basic.homEquiv_naturality_left and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Yoneda.uliftYonedaEquiv_naturality. Existing public proof retained from the Sheaf generator-coherence module.

proof.text: Expand the sections equivalence into the sheafification adjunction followed by freeSectionsEquiv. Naturality on the left of the sheafification hom equivalence moves the map of the free representable across that adjunction.

Expand freeSectionsEquiv into the whiskered free-abelian adjunction and the universe-lifted Yoneda equivalence. Apply homEquiv_naturality_left to the free-abelian adjunction, then apply uliftYonedaEquiv_naturality to a.op in the reverse direction. The resulting map is exactly F.obj.map a.op. These identities apply also to the identity arrow, empty etale objects and the zero sheaf.

lean.statement:
lemma sectionsEquiv_precomp {X : Scheme.{u}} {A B : X.Etale}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (f : (etaleOpenFreeSheaf X).obj B ⟶ F) :
    EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv X.smallEtaleTopology A F
      ((etaleOpenFreeSheaf X).map a ≫ f) =
      F.obj.map a.op (EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv X.smallEtaleTopology B F f)
